realBugsFoundAndFixed: Passenger-lift runtime-execution gap: passengerStopAllowed() was checked correctly at route-planning time but never reachable at runtime-execution time because liftHandoff.ts never set args.purpose==="passenger" -- silently stalled every resident lift ride forever with no thrown error. This was the single most consequential fix of the phase; it unblocked the entire outer golden journey.

Privacy regression in navigateToAsset's apartment-devices branch: unconditionally granted activeInteriorRef (the private 14-room map) to ANY identity, including Facility, asking Oyi about an apartment device. Fixed by gating behind the same FULL_3D RepresentationPolicy check enterInterior already uses.
homePassage's degenerate transition geometry (a 3-point crossingPath repeating its own final point) -- produced a real but improved, not fully sufficient, narration/traversal fix.

onRouteCurrentSpaceChange had no generic fallback for ROOM-kind refs -- only a hardcoded allowlist of level/lobby/interior refs updated `selected`, so internal Apartment A room arrivals via TOUR never updated 3D/2D selection even though currentSpaceRef did.

mapContext used the stale, TELEPORT/focus-only activeInteriorRef instead of a new effectiveInteriorRef that also considers the TOUR-driven currentSpaceInteriorRef -- caused the live dot to use the wrong local coordinate transform once a TOUR journey entered the apartment.

sceneActions' useMemo (App.tsx) was missing navigationMode from its dependency array -- navigateToSpace's captured enterDestination closure could read a STALE navigationMode after the user toggled TOUR/TELEPORT via the UI, a real violation of Part 2's mode-agnostic-ENTER contract. Fixed by adding navigationMode to the deps array. Found via a dedicated background investigation into verifyL06GoldStandardBrowser.mjs's flakiness.

focusRoom/enterInterior (the instant TELEPORT-style arrival functions) never cancelled a still-in-flight TOUR route left over from an earlier journey -- LunaRouteDriver.beginRoute() already refuses to START a second route while one is active, but nothing cancelled an ABANDONED one, so its queued async step callbacks (e.g. a bare-level MOVE hop through LUNA-GROUND) could fire later and silently overwrite selected/currentSpaceRef. Fixed by calling routeDriverRef.current?.cancelRoute() at the top of both functions. Verified: 3 consecutive pre-fix re-runs of verifyL06GoldStandardBrowser.mjs produced 3 different early failure symptoms (classic race condition); 3 consecutive post-fix re-runs now fail identically and much later, at an unrelated pre-existing pixel-click mechanism (see knownIssues).

knownIssues.description: A second internal multi-hop TOUR route issued immediately after the outer 'Take me home' journey completes does not advance selectedRef/currentSpaceRef past LUNA-L06-APT-A; live dot jumps once then freezes.
knownIssues.investigated: 15+ throwaway diagnostics (deleted after use); route plan confirmed correct via direct SSR requestRoute calls (status OK, 4 real TRANSITION steps); zero thrown exceptions/console errors during the stall; 3 real contributing bugs found and fixed (see realBugsFoundAndFixed) without resolving the core symptom
knownIssues.leadingHypothesisUnproven: CameraRig.tsx's pre-existing render-time ref-access pattern (independently flagged by this project's own oxlint, lines 72/124/125) plausibly fails to correctly restart CameraFlight under a specific re-render ordering when a second route begins immediately after a route-heavy first journey
knownIssues.recommendedAction: Refactor CameraRig's flight-restart logic out of the render body into a useEffect keyed on flightTarget, then re-run this exact scenario as the first acceptance check of the fix

knownIssues.description: verifyIngestionV2.mjs's derived-outline-fits-tower-footprint assertion still fails, unchanged from prior phases; Apartment A and its navigation were deliberately not distorted to satisfy it

After fixing the two real navigationMode/stale-route bugs above, verifyL06GoldStandardBrowser.mjs now fails deterministically (not intermittently) at a narrow, pre-existing, unrelated mechanism: a pixel-perfect screen-space click test for the Kitchen door hit-target that computes click coordinates from a camera preset projection without confirming the camera has finished settling first. Already disclosed as pre-existing fragility in the prior Spatial Transition Engine V1.1 report.
knownIssues.recommendedAction: Replace the fixed pause(400) after each clickDevRoom() call with a poll for real camera settle before computing door-click candidates, matching the pollFor pattern already used throughout this phase's own new tests.
